direction.description: Use `inbound` with required `from` (external party); use `outbound` with required `to` (callee).

handle.description: Party identifier compatible with the application channel contact type.

name.description: Optional display name for the party.

external_call_id.description: Stable identifier for this call in the provider system.

direction.description: Inbound calls must include `from` (external party who initiated). The channel is treated as the receiving side (e.g. agent or queue).

from.description: External party who initiated the inbound call.

started_at.description: Optional Unix timestamp (ms) when the call started.

parent_external_call_id.description: External ID of the parent call (e.g. where the call was transferred from). This will be used to thread the call into an existing conversation with a matching parent call ID.

agent_email_address.description: Optional email of the teammate associated with the call.

external_call_id.description: Stable identifier for this call in the provider system.

direction.description: Outbound calls must include `to` (callee). The channel is treated as the originating side (e.g. agent).

started_at.description: Optional Unix timestamp (ms) when the call started.

parent_external_call_id.description: External ID of the parent call (e.g. where the call was transferred from). This will be used to thread the call into an existing conversation with a matching parent call ID.

agent_email_address.description: Optional email of the teammate associated with the call.
